mechanism: Establish one shared social geography by showing the first seated pair, hand visual speaking-turn ownership within that pair, cut across the table to a second pair for a distinct response phase, then return to a wider composition that recombines all participants and the same table anchors. Source dialogue meaning is unknown; only visible turn ownership and coverage order are reusable.

invariants.rule: Establish the first subgroup and shared table anchors before any cross-table cut.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on singles hides group geography.

invariants.rule: Make speaking-turn ownership visibly readable within the first subgroup without assigning source meaning.
invariants.ablation_failure: Indistinct mouth and eye ownership makes the cut arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Cut to a second subgroup that faces back into the same shared space.
invariants.purpose: Expands the conversation while preserving geography.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new unrelated location breaks the group.

invariants.rule: Give the second subgroup one distinct response phase and one listening witness.
invariants.ablation_failure: Both people performing at once hides ownership.

invariants.rule: Recombine all participants with the same spatial anchors in a held wide view.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a pair leaves the larger group unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source beach bar and four actors
the exact male-pair to female-pair coverage
